output.need: Which individual, if any, matches all of the following criteria—being described in a 2022 article as a commercial model whose wealth largely came from showbiz; being born into a family of three children, having an industry break between 2006 and 2010, and having a child born in the United States as of 2021; entering university between 2001 and 2007 to study Business Administration and releasing a debut single between 2010 and 2015 according to a 2020 article; and being hired as a coordinator in 2012 and later promoted to manager according to that 2020 article—and what is that individual's birth name?
